description.text: The first Entry Pack, released on 27 October 2006, a month before Space-Time Creation, the first expansion of the Pokémon Card Game DP series. Made for newcomers, it held three ready-built 30-card half decks led by the final evolutions of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl starters, Torterra, Infernape and Empoleon, with a coin, damage counters and markers, a how-to-play sheet and a practice playmat, so a family or a group of friends could play again and again. It had no Pokémon LV.X.
